_: Token metadata, reviewed in PR. tools/metadata_batch.py turns this into a Safe Transaction Builder file and refuses if the chain disagrees. setMetadata REPLACES the whole entry, so every field a token should keep is written here in full -- `description` below is byte-identical to the one initMetadata wrote at launch (304 bytes, sha256 4bcce831781f9d20cd528a19e9ec928196e698617fba9c6e0ae141506adac2db); the tool refuses if it has moved.
_icon: Logos are content-addressed objects in the site's R2 bucket `hedgefun-icons`, served by server/icons.ts at /media/icons/<sha256>.png with an immutable cache and no way to overwrite a key (`onlyIf: {etagDoesNotMatch: '*'}`). The URL's own path is the sha256 of the bytes behind it, which the tool verifies with one GET. Source for the entry below: public/fd-hedgehog.png in the site repo (1024x1024 RGBA), scaled to 512x512 and stripped of its eXIf chunk -- sips writes one and validIconPng only admits sRGB/gAMA/cHRM/pHYs, so an un-stripped upload is rejected 415.

CRCLGRID.description: A strategy token on CRCL. Sell tax is paid in CRCL into an on-chain treasury nobody can withdraw from. Its rule, fixed at launch: take profit at +20% and +40%, buy back 15% dips with 20% of the reserve, never sell at a loss; profits buy the token back and burn it. Launched by the Hedgefun protocol Safe.
CRCLGRID._: The desk's own FD hedgehog on the Safe-launched first strategy. Every other launch carries its creator's icon; this one carries the protocol's on purpose. `website` is hedgefun.trade, the desk where this token trades, not hedgehood.app -- see wrangler.toml in the site repo for why they are separate registrable domains. `editor` is null: while it is, only the Safe can rewrite this entry.
